note: V3 Bollinger+RSI (video candidate). Reuses 5DC-v1A-P/trend-breakout-v1 RiskSpec/executor/portfolio/cost contract verbatim - only indicators (Bollinger lower band + RSI) and signal differ. OBSERVED exit 'High >= UpperBand -> sell' is NOT expressible in the static stop/target/time executor contract; see risk.assumptions.

signal.note: [OBSERVED] as stated in the source video. Level-triggered (no edge condition given by the video) - every qualifying day is an entry attempt; capacity handled by portfolio.
signal.observedExit: [OBSERVED] High[t] >= bb_upper[t] -> sell. Cannot be expressed by this executor contract (stop/target are static prices fixed at entry; band exit is dynamic). Deviation documented in findings/v3-engine-smoke.

risk.atrReferenceDate: t (signal date) - never t+1 or later
risk.assumptions: [ASSUMPTION] The video defines NO stop-loss and NO profit target. To satisfy the shared RiskSpec contract without inventing tuned numbers, all three constants are reused VERBATIM from 5dc_v1a_p / trend_breakout_v1 (the frozen contract values), not selected for performance:
risk.rewardRiskAssumption: [ASSUMPTION] 3.0 - same contract constant as both existing strategies
risk.maxHoldingAssumption: [ASSUMPTION] 60 sessions - same contract constant as both existing strategies; exists only to prevent unbounded holds (video has none)

gapRule: fill at session Open if Open already through stop_price

universe.primaryRequires: A1A_A1B_MERGED universe with full A2a+A2b price coverage
